# Capy of Gods

> Capy of Gods is an action roguelike where a capybara climbs a colossal tower while its weapons fire on their own. Vertical platforming meets bullet-heaven combat. Free demo on Steam.

Capy of Gods is an action roguelike in which a capybara climbs a colossal tower while its weapons fire on their own. It mixes the wave combat of a bullet heaven with classic platforming and dodge-dashing, across procedurally generated floors. The demo is free on Steam now and the full game is planned for October 2026.

- Developer: CapyEmber (one-person studio, Chile). Contact: capyember@gmail.com
- Platform: PC via Steam (Windows, Linux, macOS). Free demo available. Full release planned for October 2026.
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955600
- Trailer: https://youtu.be/9lMy9L7tKdw
- Discord: https://discord.gg/KsckWpZKXZ
